Loss report: tekton -> drone
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci pipeline.inputs (Drone has no typed pipeline inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/ci trigger.push: trigger event push, pull_request, tag (the source names no event; a Drone document with no trigger runs on every event, so the list holds the events of a push, a pull request and a tag only)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
